summary: Completed comprehensive testing of SIDETRACK Studios Duet Mode feature (Iteration 7). All backend endpoints (13/13 tests) and frontend UI elements working correctly. Duet Mode allows users to record side-by-side with another user's cover from Battle Arena.

Backend: GET /api/duets returns duets list
Backend: GET /api/duets?username=X filters by username
Backend: POST /api/duets creates duet record with battle/cover info
Backend: GET /api/duets/{id} returns specific duet with song metadata
Backend: GET /api/duets/{id}/audio returns audio data
Backend: GET /api/duets/nonexistent returns 404
Backend: GET /api/duets/nonexistent/audio returns 404
Backend: POST /api/duets with invalid battle_id returns 404
Backend: POST /api/duets with invalid cover_id returns 404
Backend: GET /api/battles/{id} returns battle with covers
Backend: GET /api/battles/{battle_id}/cover/{cover_id}/audio returns audio
Frontend: BattleArena detail view shows Duet button (Users icon) on each cover row
Frontend: Clicking Duet button navigates to DuetStudio page
Frontend: DuetStudio shows header with 'Duet Mode' text and partner info
Frontend: DuetStudio shows partner's cover section (top) with waveform bars
Frontend: DuetStudio shows user camera section (bottom) with placeholder
